ios.desc:
Prostir - Your calm, focused and stress-free daily planner

Life moves fast, and your head is easily filled with tasks, ideas, and routines. Prostir is more than just a planner. It's your well-being planner, your goal planner, your gentle habit tracker, and a safe space where you can plan your life without stress and with care.

What you can do in Prostir:

- Write down thoughts and ideas in a convenient format - without unnecessary noise
- Plan your day and see all your tasks in one place
- Form habits easily - choose the days when you want to practice them
- Organize your notes into folders - create your own spaces for different topics
- Work at your own pace - no reminders if you don't want them
- Follow your own pace, not deadlines
- 
Prostir doesn't try to change you - it helps you feel better about yourself and give space to what matters most

Try Prostir today - your mental health app, gentle to-do organizer, and digital planner - and start planning the way you feel. Take small steps, pay close attention, and move forward calmly. Because today is the day to plan without pressure.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Prostir – A calm productivity app to plan without burnout

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’ve been working on Prostir, a simple productivity app that helps you plan your day, capture thoughts, and build habits — without feeling overwhelmed.

The idea came from personal frustration: most tools either try to do everything or feel too rigid. I wanted something calmer — a space to think, not just check things off. So I built Prostir using Swift + SwiftUI, with focus on speed, minimalism, and offline support.

I’ve been building Prostir, a mindful productivity app that helps you organize your day, jot down thoughts, and build healthy habits — without getting overwhelmed.

It’s already available on the App Store and has gone through a few iterations based on early feedback. The goal has always been the same: to create a calm and simple space for planning, especially for people who find traditional task managers too rigid or stressful.

Prostir is free to try, and if anyone here wants to explore the premium features, I made a promo code specifically for the HN community:
 Use promo code in appstore: "HACKERNEWS" 
Prostir: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/daily-planner-prostir/id6535696029

Would really appreciate your thoughts or impressions. Always learning from how others approach building focused, human-friendly apps.

Would love your feedback or ideas — especially if you’ve built something similar or tried calming productivity tools before.

Thanks for checking it out!

quotes.text:
Hello, HN

I'm excited to share my Prostir app on iOS. I've noticed that most scheduling apps are similar to each other and many of them put pressure on users. Therefore, the concept of my app is a safe space where everyone can find a place for their affairs, thoughts, and habits without judgment or coercion. Instead, there is support, understanding, and freedom.

It's important for me to hear your feedback - it will help me improve my product.
Thank you for your time and thoughts!

quotes.text:
Create a space where your to-dos don’t create pressure. This app is made for those who want to plan without the stress.

Inside, you’ll find:
- To-do list with time, repetition, and importance options.

- Notes with checklists and reminders.

- Folders to organize everything.

- A soft, supportive interface – no harsh red warnings, no pushy notifications, no guilt.

- No pressure to complete everything right now – your well-being comes first.

This is a space where planning adjusts to you, not the other way around.

AppStore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/daily-planner-prostir/id6535696029
